newsitem.title: UK: IPE natural gas stable but untraded again.
newsitem.headline: IPE natural gas stable but untraded again.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures were untraded again on Thursday morning following a similarly uneventful day on Wednesday, and the tone was broadly steady.
The front two months were placed firmly beneath 10 pence per therm and July, August and September were respectively quoted at 9.7/9.8, 9.9/9.95, and 9.8/10.15 pence per therm.
These bid/offer ranges, and all of the other ranges quoted, enclosed the numbers posted at the previous day's settlement.

Bid/offer spreads were a relatively tight three tenths of a penny apart through to November but this was wider for the later months. Offers were quoted for all months, but bids were absent for October 1997, March, May and June 1998.

Physical markets softened on Wednesday with much of the business concentrated on the front periods, under pressure from system sells on the flexibility mechanism which pushed the system average price down to around 9.28 pence per therm.
